1.4Features of River Plains
We know that plains are flat or gently
rolling land surfaces. As we know that
Rivers are among the major agents of
change and play a key role in shaping the
landscape of the earth: In plains they
develop a variety of features out of which,
following features arevery common.
River Braiding: Bars of sediments
accumulateinthecourseoftheriverand
these bars dividethe river into several
channels. These channels converge and get
separated again by bars. This split of a river
into several channels, that alternately
converge and get separated is termed as
river braiding.
